messages:
ana: FYI payments flagged MERCH-242 for rapid refunds + promo stacking. Processor opened dispute D-99201 and temporarily froze settlements. Need evidence packet and timeline.

zack: Noted. Which transactions?

lana: Charges: 9003, 9004, 9005 on 2026-04-02. Refunds initiated <6 hours after capture. External note: possible card testing + promo SPRINGLAUNCH used across multiple cards.

finance-bot: Alert: refund-rate spike >10% for MERCH-242. See /billing/alerts/MERCH-242/2026-04-02

leo: I'll collect receipts, webhook delivery history, and payout CSV. Can someone check whether these refunds came from the dashboard or API keys?

zack: Quick check: dashboard audit shows two refunds by user id merch_admin, one via API key belonging to service-integration. Could be compromised keys.

ana: (typo) meant ana. Thanks @zack. Leo, pull the API key rotation history and last-used IPs. Also export chat logs with the merchant support inbox in case they asked for refunds.

leo: Running queries now. Command: `./infra/audit --acct MERCH-242 --events refund,auth --from 2026-04-01 --to 2026-04-03 > /tmp/merch242.log`

ops-bot: When assembling evidence, include: invoice PDFs, signed merchant onboarding form, refund request timestamps, masked PAN (last4) in the statement, and the merchant dashboard audit trail. Use evidence_template_v3.pdf.

zack: Added steps: 1) rotate compromised API key 2) pause payouts 3) submit evidence to processor with D-99201 id. Approving temporary payout hold for 48h.

leo: Evidence ZIP uploaded: s3://redwood-disputes/MERCH-242/D-99201/evidence_20260402.zip. Included: receipts, audit log snippet (masked), admin chat export, and admin login IPs.

ana: (again typo) ana: Also include KYC docs scan date and onboarding email chain. Processor often asks for proof merchant agreed to TOS and refund policy.

zack: Sent email to disputes@payments.vendor with subject 'D-99201 MERCH-242 evidence'. cc: legal@redwood.com.

finance-bot: Automated: dispute submission recorded. Status: evidence_submitted.

kyra: From Risk: please tag any correlated accounts that used promo SPRINGLAUNCH more than 3x in 24h. We want possible networked abuse.

leo: Added tagging. Found 7 related accounts linked by same signup IP 52.14.99.3 within 3 hours. Exported mapping to S3.

zack: Legal - looping you in if representment is needed. If processor denies, we'll need signed merchant agreement, fraud prevention steps they had, and a clear timeline.

kyra: Understood. We'll run deeper pattern match and decide on chargeback liability.

ana: Closing notes: payouts hold applied at 1900123475, evidence submitted. Will monitor processor response and update thread.
